root_cause.text: The guest kernel did not validate the host-controlled `quote_buf->out_len` before copying quote data to userspace, allowing a malicious host to specify a length larger than the allocated buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read and information leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (out_len > TDX_QUOTE_MAX_LEN) return -EFBIG;` and uses `READ_ONCE` to prevent race conditions. The CVE description explicitly states "catch scenarios where the host specifies a response length larger than the guest's allocation".
